# Tecsys

> > Tecsys delivers cloud-based supply chain management software including WMS, OMS, and healthcare solutions for complex distribution networks.

Tecsys Inc. (TSX-listed, Montreal-based) provides Elite™ supply chain solutions spanning warehouse management, order management, and healthcare inventory systems. The company serves retail, distribution, and healthcare sectors with cloud-native SaaS platforms recognized by Gartner.

## Key Topics

- Elite™ WMS (Warehouse Management System)
- Healthcare supply chain and IDN transformation
- Omnichannel retail and order fulfillment
- SaaS and cloud infrastructure
- Inventory management and optimization
- BOPIS (Buy Online, Pick up In-Store)
- Low-code application platforms (LCAP)
- Supply chain analytics and forecasting
- Peter Brereton (President & CEO)
- Gartner recognition and industry analysis
- OrderDynamics platform
- Point-of-use hospital inventory
- TSX financial performance
- Enterprise software implementation
- ESG and corporate governance

## Core Solutions & Products

- [Elite™ Healthcare Analytics | Tecsys](https://www.tecsys.com/fr-ca/solutions/analyses-de-soins-de-sante-delite): Elite Healthcare Analytics for inventory management and hospital operations
- [Point d'utilisation Elite™ Soins de Santé | Tecsys](https://www.tecsys.com/fr-ca/solutions-elite-soins-de-sante/point-dutilisation-soins-de-sante): Elite Healthcare POU: RFID and mobile-tracking for hospital inventory
- [Cloud Services | Tecsys](https://www.tecsys.com/services/cloud-services): Tecsys cloud services: managed infrastructure, disaster recovery, and PaaS
